name: AI and Data Science
subtitle: 🚧 Study plan coming soon · 124 CH
bio: Prepares graduates to analyze data and design AI models and algorithms across domains, with an emphasis on ethics and social responsibility in AI. 124 credit hours: University Req. 19-20, Faculty Req. 16, Program Req. 85 (70 core + 15 elective, max 6 CH from 3rd/4th-year CS electives), Free Electives 3-4. 🚧 Course list and prerequisites were given but not per-course credit hours or semester placement, so the interactive study plan isn't available yet.
